notes:
Summary: mid-market KM SaaS; primary product is contextual search + answers. Looking to improve surfacing by adding a reranking layer that scores candidate passages from existing embedding+ANN pipeline. Currently: embeddings store (Annoy), vanilla BM25 prefilter, then simple transformer scoring offline. Goals: replace heuristic scorer with model-based reranker endpoint; allow both online per-request rerank (up to 50 candidates) and large-scale offline scoring for nightly re-ranks.

Requirements / asks: 
- Rerank endpoint that returns stable numeric scores for up to 50 candidates; need consistent reproducibility for evals.
- Latency: aiming for p50 per-request end-to-end of <200ms; per-candidate latency target ~<30ms (ideally 10-20ms).
- Throughput: peak OLTP ~200 qps for rerank; offline scoring batch ~100k-300k candidates/day.
- Quality: want to tune relevance via eval sets (2k labeled pairs + holdout) and integrate reranker into offline A/B evaluation pipeline.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market — care about per-token and per-invocation economics; interested in batching/cache recommendations from Redwood Optimize.
- Model prefs: prefer open models or Redwood-curated quantized variants; trial with llama2-13b / mistral-7b / redwood-v1-7b-quant. Need guidance on tradeoffs for latency vs accuracy.
- Routing/fallback: want Hosted for fast trial, then Dedicated with VPC for production; fallback to smaller model variant under capacity pressure.

Notes from calls (shorthand):
- "If we can hit 30ms/candidate at our scale we'll move to Dedicated" — PM (Claire).
- SE action: provide sample rerank endpoint request/response, scoring schema, and evaluation harness example.
- They will share labeled eval set (2k pairs) and offline scoring runner to test on Dedicated POC.

Linked artifacts: pricing deck, security FAQ, and a proposed POC plan in Drive. Jira ticket created for residency question.

Sales posture: PLG-led trial, likely commit to Dedicated if POC shows measurable lift in relevance + acceptable unit cost.

Short-term next: run 2-week POC on Hosted API (rerank endpoint) using their eval set; measure nDCG/precision@k and latency. Then scope Dedicated pricing for committed capacity and VPC deployment.
